title: Absolute value of rational numbers
competency: Determine the absolute value of a rational number and solve |x| = a.

keywords.def: The distance of a number from 0 on the number line. It is never negative.
An equation of the form |x| = a.
A value that makes an equation true.

en.text: The absolute value of a number is its distance from zero, so it is never negative. We write it with two bars. |5| = 5 and |−5| = 5, because both are 5 steps from zero. For a negative x, |x| = −x, which is positive.

am.text: የቁጥር ፍጹም ዋጋ ከዜሮ ያለው ርቀት ነው፤ ስለዚህ አሉታዊ አይሆንም። በሁለት ቋሚ መስመሮች እንጽፈዋለን። |5| = 5 እና |−5| = 5 ነው፤ ሁለቱም ከዜሮ 5 እርምጃ ይርቃሉ።

screens.ask: What is the distance between 0 and 5? Between 0 and −5?
screens.after:
From 0 to 5 is 5 steps to the right.
From 0 to −5 is 5 steps to the left.
Both distances are 5. Distance has no direction, so it is never negative.
("5 and −5" mixes up the position −5 with its distance 5.)

screens.title: How far from 0?
screens.ask: Tap each point to see its distance from 0.

screens.title: Absolute value
paras: The absolute value of a number is its distance from zero.
If the absolute value is 5, the point is 5 units from zero.
Definition 1.2 has two cases. Tap each case below.

screens.title: Definition 1.2: two cases
items: A positive number or 0 stays the same. |3/4| = 3/4 and |0| = 0.
A negative number loses its minus sign. |−5| = −(−5) = 5.

screens.title: Absolute value
defs: The distance of a number from 0, written |x|. It is never negative.

screens.why:
|x| is the distance of x from 0.
−15 is 15 units left of 0.
−15 < 0, so |−15| = −(−15) = 15.
Answer: 15. (A distance is never negative, so −15 is wrong.)

screens.ask: Absolute value: work inside the bars first. |8 − 3| = ___
screens.why:
Work inside the bars: 8 − 3 = 5.
5 ≥ 0, so |5| = 5.
Answer: 5.

screens.ask: Absolute value: work inside the bars first. |0 − 10| = ___
screens.why:
Work inside the bars: 0 − 10 = −10.
−10 < 0, so |−10| = −(−10) = 10.
Answer: 10.

screens.ask: Absolute values: find each one, then calculate. |−13| − |−8| + |7| = ___
Evaluate with absolute value: if x = −5, then 5x − |x − 3| = ___
screens.clue: Put −5 in for x. Work inside the bars first.

screens.ask: Evaluate with absolute value: if x = −4 and y = 3, then |x| − |y| + |x + y| = ___
screens.why:
|x| = |−4| = 4.
|y| = |3| = 3.
x + y = −4 + 3 = −1, so |x + y| = 1.
Now 4 − 3 + 1 = 2.
(Careful: |x + y| is not |x| + |y|. Work inside first.)
screens.clue: Put the numbers in. Work inside each pair of bars first.

en.text: |x| = 8 asks: which numbers are 8 units from zero? There are two, 8 and −8. If a is positive, |x| = a has two solutions. If a is zero, there is one solution, 0. If a is negative, there is no solution, because a distance cannot be negative.

am.text: |x| = 8 ከዜሮ 8 ርቀት ላይ ያሉት ቁጥሮች የትኞቹ ናቸው ብሎ ይጠይቃል። ሁለት ናቸው፤ 8 እና −8። a አዎንታዊ ከሆነ ሁለት መፍትሔ፣ ዜሮ ከሆነ አንድ፣ አሉታዊ ከሆነ ምንም መፍትሔ የለም።

screens.title: 8 steps from 0
screens.ask: How many numbers are exactly 8 units from 0?
screens.after:
Go 8 steps right from 0: you reach 8.
Go 8 steps left from 0: you reach −8.
So two numbers are exactly 8 units from 0: 8 and −8.

screens.title: Equations with absolute value
paras: The line has two such points.
How many solutions does |x| = a have? Tap each case below.

screens.title: Solutions of |x| = a
items: x = a or x = −a. |x| = 8 gives x = 8 or x = −8.
Only 0 is 0 units from 0. |x| = 0 gives x = 0.
A distance is never negative. |x| = −3 has no solution.

screens.title: Definition 1.3
defs: An equation of the form |x| = a.
A value that makes the equation true.

screens.title: Absolute value equations: how many solutions?
screens.why:
Look at the number after the =.
Positive (13 and 3/5): two solutions, one on each side of 0.
Zero: one solution, x = 0.
Negative (−6 and −1/2): no solution, because a distance is never negative.

screens.text: Solve the absolute value equation: tap all solutions of |x| = 8.
screens.why:
|x| = 8 means x is 8 units from 0.
8 units right of 0 is 8.
8 units left of 0 is −8.
Solutions: x = 8 or x = −8. (16 and −16 are 16 units from 0.)

screens.text: Absolute value: tap all numbers whose absolute value is 3.5.
screens.why:
We need numbers 3.5 units from 0.
Right of 0: 3.5. Left of 0: −3.5.
Check: |3.5| = 3.5 and |−3.5| = 3.5.
0 has |0| = 0 and 7 has |7| = 7, so they do not fit.

|x| is a distance, so |x| is never negative.
−6 is negative.
No number has an absolute value of −6.
So there is no solution. (x = −6 is tempting, but |−6| = 6, not −6.)

screens.text: Solve the absolute value equation: tap all solutions of |x + 4| = 10.
Solve the absolute value equation: tap all solutions of |2x − 1| = 5.
screens.clue: The inside, 2x − 1, must be 5 or −5. Solve both.

items.title: Absolute value: match each x with |x|
items.why:
|x| is the distance of x from 0.
|−7| = 7 and |−2/3| = 2/3: negatives lose the minus sign.
|3/5| = 3/5: positives stay the same.
|0| = 0.

items.text: Absolute value: tap all rational numbers with absolute value 4/7.
items.why:
We need numbers 4/7 units from 0.
Right of 0: 4/7. Left of 0: −4/7.
7/4 is a different number: |7/4| = 7/4.
Answer: 4/7 and −4/7.

items.ask: Absolute values: find each one, then add. |−5| + |5| = ___
Absolute value: work inside the bars first. |−8 + 5| = ___
items.why:
Inside the bars: −8 + 5 = −3.
−3 < 0, so |−3| = 3.
Answer: 3. (|−8| + |5| = 13 is a different calculation.)

items.ask: Evaluate with absolute value: if x = 3, then |x| − x + 9 = ___

items.why:
3/5 > 0, so there are two solutions.
x is 3/5 units from 0.
Right of 0: 3/5. Left of 0: −3/5.
Solutions: x = 3/5 or x = −3/5.

test.ask: Absolute values: work inside the bars first. |−3 + 6| − |−3| = ___

test.text: Absolute value equations: how many solutions does |x| = −2 have?
test.why:
|x| is a distance, so it is never negative.
−2 is negative.
No number is −2 units from 0.
So there are 0 solutions.

test.text: Solve the absolute value equation: tap all solutions of |x| = 7.
test.why:
x is 7 units from 0.
Right of 0: 7. Left of 0: −7.
Solutions: 7 and −7. (49 is 7 × 7, not a distance of 7.)
